title: Official Connect, Switchboard and Academy images are published to the Vetra Harbor registry cr.vetra.io with one floating tag per release channel, promoted dev → staging → rc → latest
content:
Since the Docker redesign of 2026-03-29, connect and switchboard images are published **only** to Harbor:

```
cr.vetra.io/powerhouse-inc-powerhouse/connect
cr.vetra.io/powerhouse-inc-powerhouse/switchboard
cr.vetra.io/powerhouse-inc-powerhouse/academy
```

The `ghcr.io/powerhouse-inc/powerhouse/*` copies still exist but are frozen at the pre-redesign builds — pulling them gets the old layout (Connect building at container start, Prisma migrations). The images are publicly pullable.

Floating tags follow the release channels, taken from the publish workflow's "Determine additional tag" step and verified against Harbor:

| Channel | Branch | Floating tag |
| --- | --- | --- |
| dev | `main` | `dev` |
| staging | `release/staging/*` | `staging` |
| test (release candidate) | `release/rc/*` | `rc` |
| production | `release/production/*` | `latest` |

Promotion runs **dev → staging → rc → latest**. For production deployments the Academy's rule is unchanged in spirit: pin a specific version tag (`v6.2.1`) rather than any floating tag. All three images are built from a single multi-stage `docker/Dockerfile` (build args `TAG` — the release tag — and `GIT_SHA`); a shared base stage installs `ph-cmd` for the matching release channel and initializes a project, then each target builds what it needs.

_Source: apps/academy/docs/academy/03-Build/05-Launch/05-DockerDeployment.md (Powerhouse v6.2.2-dev.74)._
